output.reason: [ev-85eccdc718e3] and [ev-2941a875a468] say the istio-base Helm chart now templates Istio CRDs by default and changes their labels to match other Helm-installed resources. They also say anyone who installed or upgraded CRDs with `kubectl apply` "can continue to do so". So only environments whose istio-base Helm render now adds the CRDs or changes their labels are affected. The proposed condition is far too broad: gvk-in-use CustomResourceDefinition matches almost every cluster, and "helm" or "kubectl apply" are not container CLI flags. The corrected condition is a rendered-change on the chart's CustomResourceDefinition objects; the evidence excerpts are cut off, so confidence is low.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 templates Istio CRDs in the istio-base Helm chart by default and changes their labels to match Helm-installed resources. Exposed environments are those whose istio-base render now adds CustomResourceDefinitions or changes their labels. Installs that use kubectl apply only can continue as before.
